title: A time formatter
description:
Turn a number of seconds into hours, minutes and seconds.

```
Seconds: 9045
9045 seconds is 2 h 30 min 45 s
That is 150.75 minutes.
```

starter.main.py:
total = int(input("Seconds: "))

# TODO: hours, minutes and seconds left over

# TODO: print both lines

hints: There are 3600 seconds in an hour: `hours = total // 3600`. What is left after the hours is `total % 3600`.
Split that remainder the same way with 60 to get the minutes and the seconds.
requirements: Use `//` (whole division) and `%` (remainder) to split the seconds.
Print the minutes as a decimal with two places.
stretch: Add days when there are more than 86400 seconds, and leave out any part that is 0 (`9000` prints `2 h 30 min`).
